title: Jensen Huang told one employee his mother should have aborted him; yelled at another that he would remove the top of their head and urinate on their brain: NYT investigation
summary_full: Jensen Huang believed that his bullying had entertainmet value and it was practice inflicted on newcomers to test their resilience as to whether they could withstand Huang's episodes of public humiliation. Huang dismissed all HR complaints and said that his employees became so rich that money was no more a motivating factor for them and that's why he had to resort to bullying to push them towards more efficiency.
